_comment: site_c: BLANKET DISALLOW. robots.txt forbids every crawler from the whole
site. Content pages exist and would be full of defects, but we never fetch
them: robots.txt is a hard constraint on our own crawling, not advice.
audit_status no_content_available, and a limitations[] block stating that
no page content could be lawfully fetched and therefore no page-level check
could run. Zero page-level findings of any kind.
The trap this fixture guards against is an auditor that crawls anyway and
then reports twenty findings it had no right to collect.
